alt: Stacked horizontal bars of 2026 first-year base, maximum bonus and signing bonus at McKinsey, BCG and Bain
caption: Best-case first-year cash is $135,000 at McKinsey, $137,000 at BCG and $139,500 at Bain.
source: Source: Management Consulted, 2026 consulting salary report, 2026.
method: Chart from the undergrad side-by-side table in the draft (base salary, performance bonus cap, signing bonus); the three segments are asserted to add to the table's best-case total row

alt: Range chart of total cash at four levels from analyst to junior partner at McKinsey, BCG and Bain
caption: Total cash goes from $130,000 to $140,000 at the analyst level to $210,000 to $285,000 at the post-MBA level.
source: Source: Management Consulted, 2026 consulting salary report, 2026; Hacking the Case Interview, firm salary pages, June 2026; StrategyCase, MBB salaries, August 2026.
method: Chart from the pay ladder table in the draft (total cash ranges by level and firm); the partner row is quoted in a note under the chart because its upper end would flatten the other four levels

alt: Range bars of MBB and investment banking total cash in year one and year three, with per-hour pay
caption: Banking pays $35,000 to $85,000 more than MBB in year one and $50,000 to $95,000 more in year three.
source: Source: Management Consulted, 2026 consulting salary report, 2026; Mergers & Inquisitions, 2026 investment banker salary report, 2026.
method: Chart from the MBB vs investment banking table in the draft (total cash ranges and the gap column, which is asserted to equal the difference of the ranges); the per-hour line is parsed from the hours paragraph and its arithmetic rechecked

alt: Two bar panels of 2026 undergraduate base salary and bonus cap at MBB and seven other strategy firms
caption: Tier 2 and Big 4 strategy bases run $95,000 to $110,000 against $110,000 to $112,000 at MBB.
source: Source: Management Consulted, 2026 consulting salary report, 2026.
method: Chart from the tier 2 and Big 4 table in the draft (base and performance bonus cap columns; range cells drawn to their upper end and labeled with the range; profit-sharing notes kept in the labels)

alt: Table of 2026 federal tax brackets applied to 107,900 dollars of taxable income, four slices and a total
caption: The four slices add to $18,494 of federal income tax on $124,000 of gross pay.
source: Source: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32, 2026 tax year.
method: Table graphic from the federal bracket table in the draft (slice, rate, dollars in slice, tax); each slice's tax is asserted to equal dollars times rate and the slices to add to the total row

alt: Waterfall chart from 124,000 dollars of gross pay through five taxes to 85,187 dollars of take-home in New York
caption: Taxes take $38,813 of the $124,000, leaving $85,187 a year, or $7,099 a month.
source: Source: IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32 and New York Form IT-2105-I, 2026 tax year.
method: Waterfall from the gross-to-net table in the draft (gross pay, the five tax lines, take-home, take-home per month and share of gross); the taxes are asserted to add to the total and gross less taxes to equal take-home
